accept_specs.description: Optional mapping from edge identifiers to AcceptSpec identifiers

role_bindings.description: Mapping from step identifiers to one or more Role identifiers; selects required roles without instantiating performers

mechanism: A directed graph of {{step}}s in which completion or output from one {{solver}} can enable another. It defines the operation topology required to pursue a complex objective and can express branching, parallelism, conditional logic, or declared recursion. An edge may carry a typed {{artifact}} with an {{accept_spec}}, and a step may bind one or more {{role}}s without instantiating performers. Edge payloads, acceptance policy, and role bindings remain optional unless a descendant requires them.
failure_modes: Unresolved Cycle: A dependency cycle has no declared recursion or daemon semantics and prevents progress.
Cascade Failure: One node failure propagates to all dependents.
Orphan Output: A node produces artifacts that no downstream node consumes.
invariants: Causality: Step B cannot start before Step A's prerequisites are met.
Cycle Declaration: A dependency cycle is permitted only when its recursion or daemon semantics are explicit; otherwise dependencies are acyclic.
Declared Edge Data: When an edge carries data, it names a typed {{artifact}} rather than untyped raw data.
Binding Separation: Any declared role binding names one or more {{role}}s without instantiating performers.
